title: Is AI Making Us Worse at Cybersecurity?
description: This article discusses the potential negative impact of overreliance on AI in cybersecurity. It argues that excessive dependence on AI tools may erode essential human skills such as creativity, humor, sincerity, clear communication, and critical thinking, which are vital for effective security operations. The author emphasizes that while AI can enhance productivity, it should not replace human judgment and unique problem-solving abilities.
